provenance: AI-generated interpretive fan art; not official screenshots, verified instance layouts, bosses or loot.

items.label: The Hall of Thanes
items.alt: Generated fan art of a monumental underground dwarven hall with stone statues and torchlit stairs.

items.label: Ruins of Lordaeron
items.alt: Generated fan art of a ruined gothic courtyard and an ivy-covered gateway with a faint green glow.

items.label: Excavation Site: Wetlands
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Excavation Site: Wetlands: A sweeping archaeological dig above the marshlands: stepped excavated earth around an immense exposed ancient stone vault, dwarven timber scaffolds and cranes, carved titan relics partly uncovered, pools and green wetlands beyond.

items.label: City of Dalaran
items.alt: Generated fan art of an arcane city with violet-roofed towers and luminous magical disturbances.

items.label: The Drowned City
items.alt: Generated fan art of sea-worn coastal architecture and partly submerged columns in clear turquoise water.

items.label: Krol'dok Stronghold
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Krol'dok Stronghold: A massive outdoor ogre stronghold in lush Riverglades: oversized rugged stone towers, thick wooden spikes and iron gates, a winding river beside the fortress and green upland hills.

items.label: Alcaz Prison
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Alcaz Prison: A formidable island prison northeast of a coastal swamp: iron-barred stone gate, watchtowers, thick fortress walls, a wooden landing pier and a rocky path beside open turquoise sea.

items.label: Blackmaw Hold
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Blackmaw Hold: An interpretive vast furbolg settlement behind ancient gates in northern Azshara: colossal carved timber gate integrated into forest-cloaked rock, bear-inspired wooden totems, elevated log walkways, rooted longhouses and deep green woodland.

items.label: Shaper's Terrace
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Shaper's Terrace: An ancient titan terrace rising above the lush jungle crater of Un'Goro: monumental squared stone platforms, geometric carved pillars, a central stepped gateway with restrained blue energy, tropical ferns and immense distant crater cliffs.

items.label: Ragefire Chasm
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Ragefire Chasm: A fiery volcanic cavern beneath Orgrimmar: rugged black basalt arches framing an underground river of molten lava, a rough stone bridge, wooden supports and distant trogg silhouettes.

items.label: Wailing Caverns
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Wailing Caverns: A winding living cavern inspired by the Barrens dungeon: colossal stone columns intertwined with roots, a clear green underground stream, lush ferns and a serpentine stone formation curling over a central path, tiny druids distant only.

items.label: The Deadmines
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of The Deadmines: The unforgettable subterranean pirate harbour deep in a mine: a large wooden pirate ship moored inside a gigantic cavern, towering timber scaffold platforms, rope bridges, an abandoned minecart track approaching the harbour.

items.label: Shadowfang Keep
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Shadowfang Keep: A grand haunted gothic castle above the misty Silverpine forest, steep roofs, battlements, a central bridge to the castle gate, moonlit pine trees, subtle distant wolf-like silhouettes on the ramparts.

items.label: The Stockade
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of The Stockade: An imposing medieval stone prison corridor under Stormwind: iron-barred cells along both sides, a broad central stairway and iron gate, blue cloth without faction emblems, scattered wooden crates, a single distant guard silhouette.

items.label: Blackfathom Deeps
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Blackfathom Deeps: An ancient half-flooded temple inside a rocky coastal cavern: tall weathered night-elven pillars, broken stone causeways over clear sea water, a central submerged sanctum, barnacles and sea plants.

items.label: Gnomeregan
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Gnomeregan: A sprawling underground gnomish mechanical city: enormous bronze gears, riveted walkways, pipes and sturdy steam machinery around a central reactor chamber, a few tiny retro-fantasy robot silhouettes, clean strong engineering shapes.

items.label: Razorfen Kraul
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Razorfen Kraul: A gigantic maze of thorny roots on the dusty Barrens frontier: enormous interlocking brambles form natural archways, rough quilboar huts and leather awnings tucked among roots, raised earth paths and primitive unmarked totems.

items.label: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard: The graveyard wing of a secluded gothic monastery: rows of old carved headstones around a cloister courtyard, mossy stone mausoleum, tall cypress trees, red unmarked hanging cloth at a small chapel gate.

items.label: Scarlet Monastery: Library
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Scarlet Monastery: Library: An immense medieval monastery library: vaulted stone reading hall, towering wooden bookshelves, stairs and mezzanines, a central oak reading table with closed unmarked books, crimson unmarked cloth between archways.

items.label: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Scarlet Monastery: Armory: A grand monastery armory: vaulted stone training chamber with neatly arrayed medieval weapon racks, red unmarked banners, heavy plate armour on stands and a raised iron doorway at the far end.

items.label: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral: The great Scarlet Monastery cathedral: soaring gothic vaults, a long nave leading to a central altar, crimson unmarked banners, stained glass using only abstract colour, sunlit cloister garden visible through the entrance.

items.label: Razorfen Downs
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Razorfen Downs: A haunted thorn citadel rising from the Barrens: gigantic dry brambles coil around tiered rough stone burial towers and a central spiral path, sparse dead trees, bone-like architectural ornament but no gore.

items.label: Uldaman
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Uldaman: A dwarven excavation opening into an ancient titan vault: towering stone guardian statues flanking a geometric doorway, carved stone disks and angular columns, mining equipment left beside a central stair, dusty tunnels around the monumental hall.

items.label: Zul'Farrak
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Zul'Farrak: An ancient sand-troll city in the Tanaris desert: a monumental stepped sandstone pyramid, broad plazas, carved troll stone faces, worn obelisks and a distant dry desert horizon.

items.label: Maraudon: Wicked Grotto
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Maraudon: Wicked Grotto: The purple crystalline grotto wing of Maraudon: an immense twisting cave with violet crystals, striated lavender rock, roots around a winding central passage and a thin clear stream.

items.label: Maraudon: Foulspore Cavern
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Maraudon: Foulspore Cavern: The orange fungal cavern wing of Maraudon: huge warm terracotta cave chambers, enormous orange and red-capped mushrooms, exposed roots, a worn stone path winding above a small emerald stream.

items.label: Maraudon: Earth Song Falls
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Maraudon: Earth Song Falls: The luminous waterfall sanctuary deep in Maraudon: multiple immense waterfalls cascade into a clear turquoise pool inside a vast cavern, green hanging vines, ancient weathered centaur-inspired stone arches, a central path across pale rock.

items.label: Sunken Temple
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Sunken Temple: An ancient sunken jungle troll temple: monumental carved green-stone stairways descending into a flooded circular sanctuary, serpent-inspired stone columns and reliefs, ivy, clear shallow water and a distant shrine.

items.label: Blackrock Depths
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Blackrock Depths: An immense Dark Iron dwarven city under Blackrock Mountain: massive black-stone halls, bronze doors, tiered forge balconies, molten channels below bridges and a monumental central anvil chamber.

items.label: Lower Blackrock Spire
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Lower Blackrock Spire: The lower fortress passages inside Blackrock Mountain: rugged basalt stairways, stacked narrow bridges, ruined fortified gates, orcish wooden spikes and red unmarked cloth, a faint lava chasm below.

items.label: Upper Blackrock Spire
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Upper Blackrock Spire: The upper military fortress inside Blackrock Mountain: a grand high-vaulted black-stone arena, broad staircase, dragon-shaped carved stone guardians beside a huge central iron gate, red unmarked hanging cloth and distant defensive battlements.

items.label: Scholomance
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Scholomance: An eerie necromantic academy inside an ancient stone manor: gothic lecture hall, rows of wooden benches, aged books and stone arches, a central ritual study chamber with subtle spectral jade light, a staircase into dim vaults.

items.label: Stratholme
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Stratholme: The ruined city of Stratholme: a sweeping cobbled street of tall damaged medieval townhouses and gothic stone gates, roofs burning in the middle distance, broken carts, a central road toward a distant cathedral.

items.label: Dire Maul: East
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Dire Maul: East: The overgrown eastern quarter of Dire Maul: ancient highborne white-stone halls open to the sky, immense living roots and lush ferns reclaiming columns, green pools and a sunlit central archway, tiny plant-elemental silhouettes only.

items.label: Dire Maul: North
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Dire Maul: North: The northern ogre-occupied halls of Dire Maul: enormous weathered highborne courtyard, broad stone staircase to an oversized throne, rough wooden barricades, crude cooking fires, red unmarked cloth over classical columns, tiny distant ogre silhouettes.

items.label: Dire Maul: West
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Dire Maul: West: The western arcane quarter of Dire Maul: grand ruined highborne stone courtyard, tall elegant columns, an ancient central arcane containment structure with restrained sapphire-blue energy, deserted walkways and ivy around pale stone.

items.label: Hyjal Summit
items.alt: Generated fan art of a vast ancient world tree above green mountain forests and waterfalls.

items.label: Barrow Deeps
items.alt: Generated fan art of a subterranean forest sanctuary with ancient roots, carved arches and jade-lit pools.

items.label: Onyxia's Lair
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Onyxia's Lair: The legendary black dragon Onyxia within a vast volcanic lair in Dustwallow Marsh: a formidable black dragon with folded leathery wings stands on a broad rocky ledge beyond a cavern approach, massive horns, molten cracks illuminate obsidian rock, subtle distant eggs in sheltered side niches.

items.label: Darkspear Islands
items.alt: Generated fan art of tropical islands with timber bridges, troll-inspired towers and coloured control-point pennants.

items.label: Warsong Gulch
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Warsong Gulch: A recognizable capture-the-flag valley at the border of Ashenvale: lush forest transitions toward a rugged red-earth logging outpost, a graceful timber elven base on one side and a spiked lumber-mill stronghold on the other, plain blue and red flags at equal visual prominence, a winding open middle field.

items.label: Arathi Basin
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Arathi Basin: A pastoral Arathi Highlands battlefield: sweeping grassy basin with an old stone bridge, a lakeside blacksmith, a distant lumber mill on a ridge, farm buildings, stables and a small mine entrance woven into a beautiful panoramic landscape.

items.label: Alterac Valley
items.alt: Generated fan-art interpretation of Alterac Valley: An epic snow-covered mountain battlefield of Alterac: a wide alpine valley, snow-dusted fir trees, fortified timber watchtowers and stone bunkers, a central snowy trail between blue-banner and red-banner outposts, both sides equal.
